title: citharexylum spinosum f. smallii
intro: Citharexylum spinosum f. smallii, commonly known as "Texas sage" or "Creek sage", is a shrubby plant native to Mexico and the southern United States. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Citharexylum spinosum f. smallii include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which make it a potential remedy for insomnia, restlessness, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
